aiAnalysis.rootCause: The browser test could not connect to the application because nothing was listening on http://localhost:3000. The failure happened before any UI interaction, which strongly indicates the local app server was not running, crashed during startup, or was configured to use a different port than the test expects.
aiAnalysis.suggestion: Ensure the app is started and healthy before browser tests run, and verify the test base URL matches the actual dev server port. Add a startup/health check in the test harness so the suite fails fast with a clearer message if the server is unavailable.
